title: Declined Payments on a Pet's Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscription and Diet Days
content:
Declined payments on the pet's existing prescription Autoship take days off the diet days of a new prescription diet Autoship (an Autoship Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship for the pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription). Every declined payment attempt recorded on that existing subscription counts, the first decline and each failed automatic retry alike.

| Declined payment attempts on the existing prescription Autoship, last six months | Days off the diet days |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3 |
| exactly 1 | 1 |
| none | none |

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

**Hypothetical record.** One decline five months ago and one failed retry two days later: two attempts, 3 days off. One decline exactly six months before the day the value is worked out: it does not count.
